metadata.note: Hand-authored scaffolding geometry between the tour stops. T2.2 (FAT-21) replaces this with a walking route computed at build time.

maneuvers.instruction: Walk south on Basin Street, turn right onto St. Ann Street, and continue to the 1000 block of St. Ann.
Walk east on St. Ann Street to Bourbon Street, then turn left and walk north to 941 Bourbon.
Walk south on Bourbon Street to St. Peter Street, turn right and walk to Chartres Street, then turn left; 500 Chartres is on the right.
Walk up Chartres Street to Bienville Street, turn left, and walk to the corner of Bourbon and Bienville.
Walk north on Bourbon Street to St. Peter Street, turn left, and continue to Royal Street; Pirate's Alley begins just past the Arsenal.
Walk down Pirate's Alley to Royal Street, turn right, and continue up Royal Street to 1140.
Continue down Royal Street to Toulouse Street, turn left, and walk to 541 Bourbon.
